detector.name: EfficientDet-Lite0
detector.publisher: Google TensorFlow Lite Model Garden / Google AI Edge

rights.code_and_documentation: Official Google/TensorFlow/Google AI Edge sources provide documentation and code under their stated licenses.
rights.model_weights: The official TFHub distribution endpoint is recorded, but a separate artifact-specific redistribution license was not located.
rights.dataset: COCO image and annotation licensing/provenance is separate from the model artifact and must be retained in downstream compliance review.
rights.restriction: Use is qualified for local academic/noncommercial IRIS development and evaluation. Bundling or redistributing this exact artifact requires confirmation of the artifact and COCO terms before release.

input.resize: aspect-preserving resize to fit 320x320 with centered padding; integration must document the padding value
input.normalization: none in caller; the model input quantization is scale 0.0078125 and zero_point 127

scores.meaning: detection score, not a calibrated probability

output.nms: Included in the model graph/postprocessing; IRIS must not apply a second NMS stage.

policy.score_threshold: No IRIS threshold is frozen by qualification; preserve model outputs and select an engineering threshold only during a later validated integration step.
limitations: Does not determine damage, collision, impact direction, speed, debris, or forensic conclusions.
Publisher benchmark timings are not IRIS or Realme measurements.
Artifact/model redistribution and underlying COCO image provenance require compliance review before release.

android_plan: Reuse the existing local native TensorFlow Lite runtime used by TASK 006; no MediaPipe dependency is required for this contract. Integration is deferred to TASK 007.
